## Summary

Describe the purpose and scope of this change.

## Validation

List the checks performed.

## Documentation and architecture

- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated, or no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] Significant architectural decisions include an ADR, or no ADR is needed.
- [ ] Scenario behavior remains deterministic and reproducible where applicable.
- [ ] Authorization for private information is enforced server-side where applicable.
- [ ] Control-plane and media-plane boundaries remain clear where applicable.

## Privacy, security, and licensing

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, or private participant information are included.
- [ ] New data collection or retention is documented, purpose-limited, and time-limited where applicable.
- [ ] Third-party dependencies and assets have compatible, documented licenses, or none were added.
- [ ] This change does not alter licensing, ownership, copyright, or trademark terms without explicit owner approval.

This repository is publicly visible but proprietary. Submission of a pull request does not by itself establish contribution, licensing, or ownership terms.
